verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agent-tooling and automation platform, but nothing in treg's docs describes a scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. Its workflows are one-shot agent calls, and the 'repeat next week' use case implies manual re-running rather than built-in scheduling. A community reviewer independently describes treg as stateless APIs lacking 'webhooks, signals, schedules', which supports the absence.
